newsitem.title: UK: Sterling stuck in range vs mark and dollar.
newsitem.headline: Sterling stuck in range vs mark and dollar.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Sterling drifts around middle of day's range vs mark, off high vs dollar in afternoon Europe.

* New UK Foreign Secretary Cook in Paris on first trip abroad since taking office, says wants UK to become leading player in Europe alongside Germany and France, but declines comment on likelihood of UK joining EMU.
* Sterling at 2.8133/43 marks and $1.6380/90 vs late Tuesday's 2.8180/90 and $1.6367/77.
* Softer dolar/mark and weaker than expected industrial production data helps pound to ease. Data dampened speculation of another quick hike in base rates after Tuesday's 25 bps rise.
* UK March industrial production -0.1 pct month/month after +0.2 pct in Feb as strong sterling hits exports.
